working_definition: Author cell type 'spermatogonium' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult flies), annotated by the authors with FBbt:00004935 'spermatogonium'. Found in: 10x:testis (709 cells), ss2:testis (8 cells).
searches_performed: 'adult spermatogonium' (exact label / exact synonym, FBbt fbbt/releases/2026-10-01)

best_match.fbbt_definition: Male germline cell found in the spermatogonial cyst. It specifically expresses bag of marbles (bam), which is required for its differentiation (Witt et al., 2019).

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00004935 'spermatogonium', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
recommendation: Map to the authors' term FBbt:00004935 'spermatogonium', exact match.
